title: Meta puts its Muse AI agent inside Instagram DMs and partners with Walmart on Black Friday deals

sources.name: TechCrunch (Aisha Malik) - Muse in Instagram DMs
TechCrunch (Lauren Forristal) - Walmart and Meta Muse
The Decoder - Amazon and Meta talks over Muse

kept.claim: Meta integrated its Muse AI agent into Instagram DMs, so users can chat with Muse in a DM thread.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'Meta integrated Muse into Instagram DMs'. Source 2: 'Instagram users can now chat with Meta's AI agent Muse in a DM thread, the company announced on Tuesday.' Caveat: Meta's own newsroom post was not fetched (the web_fetch tool limit was reached), so no primary source has been read.

kept.claim: Walmart partnered with Meta so customers can shop Walmart's Black Friday deals through Muse.
kept.evidence: Source 0: Meta 'partnered with Walmart to make Black Friday deals accessible through Muse'. Source 3: Walmart is 'teaming up with Meta to let customers shop its Black Friday deals through Muse'. Walmart's own announcement (corporate.walmart.com) is linked from source 3 but could not be fetched, so it is not a source.

kept.claim: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse shopping agent in September 2026. Amazon and Meta are reportedly in talks to lift the block, and no deal has been announced.
kept.evidence: Source 1: 'Amazon and Meta discussed lifting Amazon's September block'; 'companies have yet to announce a deal'. Source 4: the two are 'in talks' to end the block on Muse. Its earlier-coverage link is dated Sep 21, 2026.

kept.claim: Ad revenue and control over search results are the main sticking points in the Amazon–Meta talks.
kept.evidence: Source 1: advertising revenue and control over search results 'remain under negotiation'. Source 4, citing Fortune: these are the main sticking points.

kept.claim: Amazon's advertising business brings in $68.6 billion a year.
kept.evidence: Source 1: 'Amazon's $68.6 billion annual advertising business'. Source 4: 'a business that brings in $68.6 billion a year'. Annual figure.

kept.claim: Muse accounted for 51% of all agentic shopping orders, ahead of Grok at 24% and ChatGPT at 22%. The Decoder attributes the data to Forter Intelligence, and the figure is a share of AI-agent orders, not of all online orders.
kept.evidence: Source 1: Muse 'accounts for 51% of AI-agent shopping orders'. Source 4: 'Muse recently accounted for 51 percent of all agentic orders' per Forter Intelligence, followed by Grok at 24 percent and ChatGPT at 22 percent. Source 4 calls Grok 'SpaceX's Grok'. Source 1 does not print the Grok and ChatGPT shares.

kept.claim: Amazon's decision to block third-party AI agents from making purchases contrasts with Walmart's approach of welcoming them.
kept.evidence: Source 3: Amazon 'has taken steps to stop third-party AI agents from making purchases', while Walmart 'is leaning into the idea'. Source 4 covers Amazon's block on Muse.

dropped.claim: Meta announced the Instagram DM integration on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. The Neuron digest reported it a day later, on November 25.
dropped.evidence: Source 2 is dated November 24, 2026 and says Meta announced it 'on Tuesday'. Source 0 is dated Nov 25 and links to the Nov 24 TechCrunch story but prints no announcement date itself. Only one source states this date.

dropped.claim: In Instagram DMs, Muse can give users more context about a post, place or product, and can catch them up on DM conversations they missed.
dropped.evidence: Source 2: users can chat with Muse 'to get more context about a post, place, or product' or 'catch up on conversations they may have missed'. Single source.

dropped.claim: Users can share Instagram posts with Muse and ask it to act on them, for example adding a coffee shop to a Mexico City itinerary or finding a Black Friday deal on shoes.
Muse in Instagram DMs began rolling out Tuesday on iOS and Android in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Japan and Singapore.
dropped.evidence: Source 2: rollout 'for iOS and Android users in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Japan, and Singapore'. Single source.

dropped.claim: Conversations with Muse on Instagram appear as a side chat in the main Muse app.
dropped.evidence: Source 2: 'conversations with Muse on Instagram will appear as a side chat in the main Muse app'. Single source.

dropped.claim: Meta also launched a feature, starting Tuesday in the U.S. and Canada only, where Muse can organize saved Instagram posts and reels into Collections. A prompt appears when a user saves a post.
dropped.evidence: Source 2: 'Starting Tuesday, when users save a post on Instagram, they will see a prompt for Muse to organize it... launching in the U.S. and Canada.' Single source.

dropped.claim: Meta says nothing is shared, published or sent from Muse on Instagram without user approval. Users can ask Muse to forget information or undo actions.
dropped.evidence: Source 2 gives this as Meta's statement. Single source.

dropped.claim: The Walmart–Meta partnership was announced Tuesday, November 24, 2026, and is described as live now.
dropped.evidence: Source 3 is dated Nov 24, 2026. It says the partnership was 'announced Tuesday' and 'Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse'. Single source.

dropped.claim: To use it, a user opens the Muse app, signs in to their Walmart account, and returns to the assistant. Muse sends requests to Walmart, which returns products and helps build a cart.
dropped.evidence: Source 3 describes this sign-in and request flow. Single source.

dropped.claim: Walmart says Muse does not get access to a customer's Walmart shopping history or other personal information. Shoppers can set spending limits, require approval before purchases, review orders placed by the agent, and delete the agent's profile.
dropped.evidence: Source 3 reports these as Walmart's privacy protections. Single source.

dropped.claim: The experience runs on Walmart's Agent Gateway. It launched in October, and Walmart plans to open it to more developers and AI platforms.
dropped.evidence: Source 3: powered by 'Walmart's Agent Gateway', which 'launched in October'. Single source.

dropped.claim: Instacart has also recently teamed up with Meta's Muse.
dropped.evidence: Source 3: 'Instacart also recently joined forces with the AI assistant.' Single source.

dropped.claim: Muse has more than 10 million users in the US and Canada. The Decoder calls it Meta's most successful consumer AI product so far.
dropped.evidence: Source 4 states this. Single source, so not confirmed by a second source.
